messages:
ashok: Quick sync 1: thinking about a small companion 'gpu-metrics-exporter' that plugs into our inference containers and emits device-level metrics + OTLP traces to Datadog via an OpenTelemetry collector. Target: Dedicated + Private customers w/ GPU fleets. Thoughts?

maria: Very useful. Ops always asks for per-GPU metrics (mem_util, sm_util, power_watts) correlated with inference spans. Can we keep it tiny (go binary) and config-driven?

greg: I can prototype a Go exporter that reads NVML and emits OTLP metric + resource attributes (gpu.uuid, gpu.model). Will also include a config flag to attach model metadata (model.name, quantized=true).

kevin: From the Datadog side, we'll want standard metric names and tags so dashboards/monitors are reusable. Proposed tags: redwood_model, device_type, env, customer_id. Any objections?

maria: Sounds good. Also add seq_len and batch_size as span attributes so traces show correlation between batch and latency.

ashok: Important for Private installs: document TLS options and proxying to internal OTLP collector. Add a snippet for systemd + containerized modes.

greg: Will add both examples. Example config for collector to bridge OTLP -> Datadog:```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "${DD_API_KEY}"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

kevin: For the Datadog dashboard, let's include: 1) per-GPU utilization heatmap, 2) 99th percentile inference latency by model, 3) trace waterfall for a sample request. I can sketch the queries.

maria: I'll generate a sample dashboard JSON under /dashboards/gpu-observability.json. Will include a sample graph that uses `avg:system.gpu.utilization{*} by {redwood_model,device_type}` and a trace search filter `service:inference AND resource.name:infer`.

infra-bot: CI pipeline triggered: obs-gpu-exporter/proto -> build (linux/amd64) started.

greg: Adding a smoke test to CI: run exporter + local collector + dd-agent container and verify metrics show up via Datadog API. Command:```
docker-compose -f ci/docker-compose.yml up -d
./bin/gpu-exporter --config ci/config.yaml &
# run small inference to generate spans and metrics
python ci/generate_load.py --requests 10
```

ashok: Marketplace/partner checklist: legal signoff on logo use, co-branded blurb, an approved tech contact list, and a short integration guide (1 pager). Marketing-bot please add deadline reminders.

marketing-bot: Added milestone: assets due 2026-05-10 for a target publish of 2026-05-20. Reminder will ping 10 days prior.

kevin: Also ask Datadog integration team for a partner tile (marketplace). I'll open the partner intake form and share the tracker.

maria: UX ask: can we include a small trace sample in the repo README with an image and a link to an interactive trace in Datadog? That helps customers see end-to-end correlation immediately.

greg: Yep I'll add `examples/trace-sample.json` and a script to push it to the collector.

ashok: Recap: greg = exporter + CI; maria = dashboard + README + examples; kevin = Datadog liaise + queries; ashok = partner checklist + private install notes; marketing-bot handles milestones. Next quick sync Thu 9am PT. Post blockers here. Thanks :thumbsup:
